PRODUCT_NAME: Heratherm 2.3 cu. ft. (65 L) General Protocol Oven, Mechanical Convection, 120V
DESCRIPTION:
Thermo Scientific™ Heratherm General Protocol Ovens are ideally suited for routine applications, with sample safety in mind. The Heratherm General Protocol ovens line is perfect for routine day to day work, providing the ideal heating and drying solution for research, clinical or industrial needs. Heratherm General Protocol Ovens provide a choice of gravity convection for gentle drying and heating, or mechanical convection for faster drying and heating, and superior temperature uniformity. Gravity convection units are designed to protect delicate samples while offering temperature uniformity of +/-4°C or better, and temperature stability of at least +/-0.4°C at 150°C. Mechanical convection models provide temperature uniformity of +/-4.0°C or better, and temperature stability of at least +/-0.4°C at 150°C.

• Operating temperatures from 50° to 250°C
• Automatic over-temperature alarm system to protect samples
• Low overall energy consumption
• Built in timer
• Excellent footprint/volume ratio
• Corrosion-resistant galvanized steel chambers with rounded corners for easy cleaning
• Large, easy to read vacuum fluorescent display
• Easy to use, microprocessor-controlled touch button operation
• Easy to access - doors can be opened to over 180°C
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

DESCRIPTION:
SPARTHA Medical develops active interfaces/multifunctional coatings using biopolymers and in-house machine learning platforms. Based on client specifications for a specific product and/or material we develop formulations that are antibacterial, antiviral, antifungal, anti-inflammatory, pro-regenerative, anti-fouling.

SPARTHA Medical is an SME originated from National Institute of Health of France (INSERM) laboratory specialized in coatings for 25 years; thus, we develop additional features (anti-adhesive, pro-adhesion (cells), anti-friction, antioxidant, etc.) using our own platform.

 

Thanks to that, we offer a platform of tailor-made coating service to meet your needs or to solve your problems. It ranges from proof of concept (PoC) to licensing agreements and include:

• Multifunctional coatings by spray or automated dipping

• End use case-based test development, mimicking as much as possible a real usage environment

• Environmentally friendly and sustainable production processes

• Coating development using Artificial Intelligence

• Testing activity (antimicrobial, antifungal, cell adhesion, fouling etc.) with specific coating

• Consulting with our biofilm, biomaterials and regulatory experts

• Standard Operation Procedure (S.O.P.) service for coating transfer to industrialization

 

Please visit https://sparthamedical.eu/services/ website for more information.

Don't hesitate to contact us at leon@sparthamedical.eu

PRODUCT_NAME: CapTrack, Model CT2, Benchtop Recapping Archiver with Position Database, 120-240V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
Captrack is the worlds first and only benchtop recapping and sample management system. Captrack is the solution for increased efficiency, sample integrity and safety in blood processing laboratories.

CapTrack™ is available in 3 models:
• CT1 - Automated tube recapping, tracking and sample management with tube height and cap color recognition recall function.
• CT2 - Automated tube recapping, tracking and sample management with rack position recall function.
• CR1 - Automated tube recapping functionality.

Specifications:
• Samples Processed / Hour: Approx. 450
• Database Capacity: 100,000 entries
• Languages: English, French, German, Spanish (expandable)
• Operating Temperature: +5°C to +30°C
• Cap Capacity: Approx. 1500
• Cap Style: Unique 12/13 mm flanged CT Caps
• Max. Sample Capacity: 48 Specimen Tubes (40 accessible when idle)
• Tubes Processed: 12 to 13 mm diameter
• Power Requirements: Single-phase, 120V-240V, 50Hz/60Hz, 160W, 1.5A
• Dimensions (L x W x H): 22.523 x 20.718 x 14.159 in.
• Weight: 65 lbs
• Additional features: 7 in. touchscreen, color status carousel nests, RFID reader, ethernet port
• Warranty: All CapTrack™ models include a standard 1 year warranty, parts and labor. Extended warranties are available for all models of CapTrack™

AltraBio offers comprehensive clinical data analysis services, leveraging statistical expertise to support your clinical research projects from inception to publication. Our experienced statisticians provide tailored solutions across various therapeutic areas, ensuring high-quality and reliable results.


Key Benefits

  • Expertise Across Therapeutic Areas: Extensive experience in neuropsychiatry, neurosciences, pulmonology, immunology, dermatology, cardiology, rheumatology, and more.
  • Customized Solutions: Tailored to meet the specific needs of pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, biotechs, cosmetic and nutritional industries, and academic laboratories.
  • Comprehensive Services: Covering all phases from development to post-market clinical follow-up.
  • Advanced Analytical Methods: Utilizing machine learning, data mining, and complex statistical models for in-depth analysis.
  • Quality and Reliability: Ensuring data integrity and reproducibility through rigorous quality controls and standardized processes.

Services

  1. Study Design
  • Sample size and power calculation
  • Synopsis writing and definition of analysis methodology
  • Development of the Statistical Analysis Plan
  1. Data Collection
  • Support for Data Management Plan writing
  • Selection and implementation of eCRF

  1. Data Analysis and Valorization
  • Descriptive and comparative analyses
  • Construction of explanatory or predictive models

  • Writing of abstracts, posters, and research articles

  • Machine learning methods and data mining
  • Power estimation, survival analysis, log-rank test, Cox model

  • Automation of quality controls and outlier identification

  • Initial import of raw data and gating workspaces
  • Preprocessing, data quality control, and normalization
  • Predictive modeling, correlation identification, and advanced visualization
  • Reagent panel selection and gating strategy optimization

PRODUCT_NAME: CapTrack, Model CR1, Automated Tube Recapper, 120-240V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
Captrack is the worlds first and only benchtop recapping and sample management system. Captrack is the solution for increased efficiency, sample integrity and safety in blood processing laboratories.

CapTrack™ is available in 3 models:
• CT1 - Automated tube recapping, tracking and sample management with tube height and cap color recognition recall function.
• CT2 - Automated tube recapping, tracking and sample management with rack position recall function.
• CR1 - Automated tube recapping functionality.

Specifications:
• Samples Processed / Hour: Approx. 450
• Database Capacity: 100,000 entries
• Languages: English, French, German, Spanish (expandable)
• Operating Temperature: +5°C to +30°C
• Cap Capacity: Approx. 1500
• Cap Style: Unique 12/13 mm flanged CT Caps
• Max. Sample Capacity: 48 Specimen Tubes (40 accessible when idle)
• Tubes Processed: 12 to 13 mm diameter
• Power Requirements: Single-phase, 120V-240V, 50Hz/60Hz, 160W, 1.5A
• Dimensions (L x W x H): 22.523 x 20.718 x 14.159 in.
• Weight: 65 lbs
• Additional features: 7 in. touchscreen, color status carousel nests, RFID reader, ethernet port
• Warranty: All CapTrack™ models include a standard 1 year warranty, parts and labor. Extended warranties are available for all models of CapTrack™

PRODUCT_NAME: 2D Barcode 3.0 mL Cryogenic Vial, Self-Standing, External Thread, Sterile 99/rack, 8 Racks /cs, 648 vials/cs
DESCRIPTION:
The materials and quality of NEST 2D barcode cryogenic vials are the same as NEST common cryogenic vials. They can be used with Biobank system.

• USP VI Polypropylene
Each tube is permanently marked with a unique 2D barcode, ensuring the tubes can be easily and accurately identified when being moved, shipped or even accidentally dropped.
• Laser 2D barcode on the bottom of each tube allows scan and decode at once without removing from rack.
• 100% inspection guarantees that each code is unique and readable.
• Non-pyrogenic, DNase/RNase and human DNA free
• Round Bottom, Self-standing
• Solid, one-piece construction ensures the barcode not fall off during the storage under low temperature
• Autoclavable
• Sterilized by E-beam, SAL10-6
• Clear graduations and white marking area
• Recommend to store in gas phase of the nitrogen tank
• External thread Cap: Special screw cap designed without silicone ring to avoid the contamination risk.
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.
